name: Shortness of Breath
summary: A feeling of difficulty breathing or not getting enough air.
points: Can occur during activity or even while resting
May be linked to heart or lung conditions
Sudden or severe breathing difficulty needs urgent medical attention

character: Waking up at night short of breath
pattern: Any time, without a clear pattern
modifiers: Gets worse when walking or climbing stairs

name: Chest Discomfort
summary: Pain, pressure, tightness, or heaviness felt in the chest.
points: Can be related to heart or circulation problems
May occur together with sweating, nausea, or shortness of breath
Severe or persistent chest discomfort needs urgent medical attention

location: Spreads to the arm, neck, jaw or back
pattern: Any time, without a clear pattern
associated: Pain spreading to the arm, jaw or back

name: Dizziness
summary: A feeling of lightheadedness, spinning, or unsteadiness.
points: Can be linked to low blood pressure or dehydration
Sometimes caused by medication side effects
May increase the risk of falls in older adults

character: Spinning, like the room is moving
pattern: Any time, without a clear pattern
modifiers: Gets better when sitting or lying down

name: Fatigue
summary: A persistent feeling of tiredness or low energy.
points: May occur with diabetes, heart disease, or other chronic conditions
Not always relieved by resting or sleeping
Can also be related to medication effects or poor sleep

pattern: Any time, without a clear pattern

name: Leg or Ankle Swelling
summary: Swelling caused by fluid buildup in the legs, ankles, or feet.
points: May occur with heart, kidney, or circulation problems
Can become more noticeable after standing for long periods
Sudden swelling on one side should be checked by a healthcare professional

character: Soft, leaves a dent when pressed
pattern: After standing or sitting for a long time
Any time, without a clear pattern
modifiers: Gets worse after standing or sitting for long
Gets better when legs are raised

name: Palpitations
summary: A feeling that the heart is racing, pounding, or skipping beats.
points: May happen during activity or while resting
Can be linked to heart rhythm changes or certain medications
Palpitations with chest pain or fainting need urgent attention

pattern: Any time, without a clear pattern

name: Headache
summary: Pain or pressure felt in the head or upper neck.
points: Can be dull and constant, or sharp and throbbing
May be linked to stress, dehydration, or blood pressure changes
Sometimes a side effect of medication

character: Sudden and very severe (the worst ever)
pattern: Any time, without a clear pattern
modifiers: Gets worse with bright light or noise

name: Blurred Vision
summary: Difficulty seeing clearly or a noticeable change in eyesight.
points: Can occur with diabetes or blood pressure problems
May affect one or both eyes
Sudden vision loss or major changes need urgent medical attention

character: Blind spot or partial loss of vision
pattern: Any time, without a clear pattern
modifiers: Gets worse with reading or screen use

name: Frequent Urination
summary: Needing to urinate more often than usual.
points: Can be linked to diabetes or certain medications
May also happen more often during the night
Sometimes occurs together with increased thirst

name: Excessive Thirst
summary: Feeling unusually thirsty even after drinking fluids.
points: Can be linked to high blood sugar
May occur together with frequent urination
Can also happen with dehydration

name: Low Blood Sugar Symptoms
summary: Symptoms that may occur when blood sugar drops too low.
points: Can include sweating, shaking, hunger, or dizziness
May also cause confusion or irritability
Severe symptoms such as seizure or loss of consciousness are an emergency

name: Numbness or Tingling
summary: A pins-and-needles feeling or reduced sensation in part of the body.
points: Can occur in the hands, feet, or legs
May be linked to diabetic nerve damage
Sudden numbness on one side of the body needs urgent medical attention

name: Persistent Cough
summary: A cough that continues for a long time or keeps returning.
points: Can be dry or produce mucus
May be linked to lung disease or certain medications
Coughing blood or having severe breathing difficulty needs urgent care

name: Wheezing
summary: A whistling sound heard while breathing.
points: Often happens when the airways become narrowed
May occur with asthma or chronic lung disease
Severe wheezing with breathing difficulty needs urgent attention

name: Joint Pain or Stiffness
summary: Pain, aching, or difficulty moving one or more joints.
points: Can become worse after long periods of inactivity
May be linked to arthritis or gout
Swelling and redness may occur during flare-ups

name: Muscle Weakness
summary: A noticeable decrease in strength or ability to perform normal movements.
points: Can make walking or daily activities more difficult
May be linked to illness, medication effects, or poor nutrition
Sudden weakness on one side of the body needs urgent medical attention

name: Constipation
summary: Difficulty passing stool or having bowel movements less often than usual.
points: Can be related to low fluid intake or reduced activity
Certain medications may also cause constipation
Persistent constipation should be discussed with a healthcare professional

name: Nausea
summary: An uneasy, queasy feeling in the stomach, often with an urge to vomit.
points: Can be triggered by certain medications
May also be linked to digestive problems or illness
Persistent vomiting can lead to dehydration

name: Loss of Appetite
summary: A reduced desire to eat or decreased interest in food.
points: Can lead to weight loss or poor nutrition
May occur with illness, medication effects, or nausea
Persistent loss of appetite should be monitored

name: Sleep Disturbance
summary: Difficulty falling asleep, staying asleep, or getting restful sleep.
points: Can be affected by pain, breathing problems, or frequent urination
Poor sleep may increase daytime fatigue
Some medications can also affect sleep
